Package fr.imta.smartgrid.model

Class EVCharger

java.lang.Object
fr.imta.smartgrid.model.Sensor
fr.imta.smartgrid.model.Consumer
fr.imta.smartgrid.model.EVCharger
@Entity public class EVCharger extends Consumer
JPA entity representing an EV Charger sensor. A Consumer that charges electric vehicles. Mapped to the "ev_charger" table using joined inheritance.
